title: A2UI Interaction Kit
description: Adds semantic, reusable interactions to agent-generated interfaces.
instructions: Use InteractiveItem for agent tasks, approvals, opportunities, and actionable rows. Declare only supported capabilities. An external capability is actionable only when its matching on* Action property is supplied. Use stable itemId values. The host application owns authorization, backend persistence, and all data mutations. Prefer reversible actions where available; never interpret dismiss as delete. Do not invent tool names or claim an interaction succeeded before the application confirms it.

InteractiveItem.description: A task or information card with accessible controls, touch swipe-to-dismiss, optional details, prioritization, selection and an application action.
